title: 八万亿现金不走了：道富它已成持久资产，资金为何不愿入市？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Xi Jinping, President and Chief Executive Officer of State Street Investment Management, Xi Jinping, thank you so much for being with us. Always a pleasure to speak with you.
segments.zh: 习近平，道富**管理公司总裁兼首席执行官，非常感谢您的到来。与您交谈总是很愉快。

segments.en: One of the reasons why I love speaking with you is because you can take a look at the flows.
segments.zh: 我喜欢与您交谈的原因之一是，您可以观察资金流向。

segments.en: And just how much people are rearranging ahead of some of this data. And frankly, in the wake of the performance that we've already seen, I'm just wondering how much you're seeing people
segments.zh: 以及在这些数据公布之前，人们是如何调整布局的。坦率地说，鉴于我们已经看到的市场表现，我想知道您是否看到人们

segments.en: with draw cash following the momentum unwind or frankly taking cash that they had in money market funds and starting to deploy it in more significant ways.
segments.zh: 在动量交易逆转后撤出现金，或者坦率地说，将货币市场基金中的现金以更显著的方式投入市场。

segments.en: You know, what we've seen all year is that money is moving into money market funds.
segments.zh: 今年我们看到的情况是，资金一直在流入货币市场基金。

segments.en: It hasn't really shifted even though the market regime has changed.
segments.zh: 尽管市场环境发生了变化，但这种情况并未真正改变。

segments.en: And I think in large part because expectations of yields remaining at more elevated levels than they've been is attractive and is an opportunity to leverage it for opportunistic moves into the market.
segments.zh: 我认为很大程度上是因为，收益率预期保持在比以往更高的水平，这具有吸引力，并且是利用这一机会进行市场布局的契机。

segments.en: But it is becoming what we see as a durable asset class.
segments.zh: 但这正成为我们眼中的一种持久性资产类别。

segments.en: So it's a durable asset class at a time where people are expecting the Fed to likely remain unhold or potentially raise rates at some point. I'm just wondering what it would take to
segments.zh: 因此，在人们预期美联储可能按兵不动或可能加息的情况下，这是一种持久性资产类别。我想知道，要怎样才能

segments.en: unlock that eight trillion dollars in money market funds or wherever it is right now.
segments.zh: 释放货币市场基金中那八万亿美元的资金，或者无论现在具体是多少。

segments.en: To go into the financing of the data center build out that we see every single day with Intel necessarily raising another $15 billion in equity as they were just announcing.
segments.zh: 谈到数据中心建设的融资，我们每天都能看到英特尔宣布再融资150亿美元。

segments.en: Well, you know, what we've seen is that investors are really wanting to barbell their portfolios.
segments.zh: 我们看到市场参与者确实希望构建杠铃式**组合。
